notes.ki_049: Erratum (KNOWN_ISSUES KI-049, ERRATA.md): seed 0's generated training row is miscomputed (24.62 ms/step). Correct: 42.2 ms/step for the completed segment (35,000 steps in 1,477 s, 0.41 h); 0.70 h in total including the cut first segment. Billed amounts and every success, interval and separation are unaffected.
notes.not_separated: 'not separated' means the 95 % interval of the paired difference includes 0; it is not evidence of equivalence.
notes.privilege_level1: Level 1 policies observe privileged simulator object state (cube/can pose) and robot proprioception; they are not vision policies.
notes.privilege_level2: Level 2: one 512-point world-frame cloud from depth + calibration of two 84² cameras, + 9-D proprioception; sensor-like, no segmentation or object pose (D-083). DP3-inspired, not a DP3 reproduction.
